result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by eliminating liquidated damages and penalties and replacing them with ordinary late-payment interest. However, it is not minimal: it extends the delinquency period from 10 to 30 days, adds an undisputed-invoice condition, and makes interest Vendor’s sole late-payment remedy. That sole-remedy language may unintentionally eliminate suspension, termination, collection-cost, or other contractual remedies, so the original commercial intent is not fully preserved. The drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
